_comment: Third-party modules bot/ imports that are deliberately NOT in
requirements.lock, each with the reason. A ratchet in both directions:
a new entry means somebody added a dependency without pinning it, and an
entry that gets pinned must be deleted in the same commit.
Pillow is NOT in here. It is guarded at all eleven of its import sites,
which made it look optional — and that is exactly how cards vanished on
2026-08-17 with no error. A guarded import means the code SURVIVES the
absence, not that the feature is expendable.

optional.matplotlib: Chart rendering (bot/skills/chart_renderer.py). Not installed in any environment today, so the chart path has never run. Pin it or delete the module — but that is a product decision, not a lockfile one.
optional.mplfinance: Candlestick charts, same module and same status as matplotlib.
optional.pandas: Dataframes for the chart renderer only. Same status.
optional.eth_account: EVM transaction signing (bot/web/web3_signer.py). Not installed anywhere; the signer path is unreachable as shipped.
optional.eth_utils: Same module, same status as eth_account.
optional.rlp: Same module, same status as eth_account.
